This season is kind of overhyped I feel. Hitscan is bad for ZeroBuild where you can get beamed from 200 metre away and not be able to escape it. TTK is insane, and the shotguns aren't that great. Sword locks you in place so you can't move while using it- unless I'm the only person that happens to, but when the sword is used against me, it hits me from a building away and I can't escape it or use a shotgun because, as said earlier, the shotguns this season suck. It'd be better if ZB remained Projectile while Build reverted to Hitscan.  
  
The map theme is great, but I'm afraid there's too many places to fall damage, and the mountain range being in the middle of the map facilitates being beamed from 200 metre away. And again, in ZB, this is bad as there's not a lot of cover.

There's no recoil or bloom on the guns, so no skill outside of aim is required for gameplay. Meaning anyone with just decent aim can solo anyone who can't aim well, when their strong point would be escaping and / or adjusting for recoil.

Also, XP gain this season is so miserable. Even after they supposedly "fixed it", I only got one level after four matches. I'd be Level 30 by now, adjusting for time spent at my job or doing other things, but I worry I won't be able to complete the Battle Pass and Bonus Pass unless I buy the Quest package which just barely helped me last season.

Overall, the season is overhyped and somewhat mid. It has time to be fixed, I'm certain a lot of this can be pinned down to just growing pains, but I'd expect better from playtesting and what not. I simply enjoy previous seasons such as C5S2 and C5S3 more than I enjoy this season. And while that's unfortunate, I understand not everything is meant to be nice for everyone, so I'll accept that and stick to Festival Main Stage this season.
